notes.title: "Vampires x Military Uniforms x Yuri" The Vampire's Bride: The Novel Game will be released!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/da6fdedfd0cb8945e65b80f74218c30c65a1cfc2.jpg[/img]
The Vampire's Bride: The Novel Game will be released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109650

Vampdoll: The Blood-Drinking Maidens

...They are girls who can only survive by drinking the blood of other girls.
To exterminate the grotesque beings known as "Werewolves",
they fight under the code name "Stray Dog Carnage".
As their "rations", they are provided with girls known as "Bride Thorns".

[h2]About the Game[/h2]
This game is a "yuri" girls' love story, where you witness the emotions between girls who have become vampires and their human partners.
What endings will they each choose...?

[h2]Synopsis[/h2]
The era is Meiji.

Sana Shirafuji, who lost her grandmother and is left alone in the world,
knocks on the military's door to become a "Bride Thorn" to make a living.

A "Bride Thorn" is a "ration" for girls known as "Vampdolls",
who are specialized in combat.
Unaware of this, Sana accepts the military contract out of desperation.
On her first day of enlistment, she meets
Yukine Hanafusa, a beautiful yet disdainful Vampdoll.

Gradually, Sana and Yukine begin to understand each other.
On the first night of blood drinking,
they discover that the act of drinking blood brings physical and emotional exhilaration.
Despite their awkwardness, they experience their first blood drinking together.

Some time later, Yukine becomes incapacitated during a certain operation...

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list][*]Diverse graphics by manga artist Saku Takano.
[*]A story that captures the delicate emotions of the girls.
[*]A pure love girls' love story with the concept of "Vampires x Military Uniforms x Yuri".[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/4fc3d34dba4b2228ac98be23c20a4398123e45ea.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/ab71bbd5818cb9f64f71c1fd077866196f8f77cc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 新角色情报公开！
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36792781/89ba4c05b87879c6e549aea10638c2b2e1c4c85d.png[/img]
[h1]本作品内出现角色的最新情报公开！[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1931940/_/

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36792781/0842b8287c8b531880d654c6b244ca5cb890aa8c.png[/img]
[h1]笹森蕾[/h1]
花的姐姐。
目前因为临产的原因，暂时回到娘家居住。
比花显得大方稳重，时不时的一些发言会显露出她天然的一面。
作为姐姐，时常引导着迷茫的花走出困境。
在母亲去世之后，担负起照顾花的责任，守候在花的身边。

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36792781/983b663fbf01c3d486d2fefd73b28f4965ccfab6.png[/img]
[h1]笹森育[/h1]
花与蕾的父亲。
曾经是个性格大大咧咧的人，在某件事情之后，变得爱担心起来。
花也因为这过分的担心而感到困扰，但她明白这是属于父亲的温柔。


今后我们还将继续向大家报告本作品的最新情报！还请加愿望单来关注我们哦！

notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36792781/594de9b911f668aeb60d820ef1f395b3d14cb232.png[/img]

[h1]『提早绽放的黑百合』STEAM商店页面以及官方网站正式公开啦！
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1931940/_/

『提早绽放的黑百合』是由日本知名插画师fukahire担任原案·原画的作品，是在一个连“喜爱”这个感情的表达都会被忌讳的世界里，贯彻了“喜爱”与“诅咒”的百合恋爱游戏！

玩家将为了指引两位女孩子的心情而介入这个世界的选择项中，然后为她们写入决定命运的“词汇”。
利用这个系统，还请将「花」与「树」引领向幸福。
